evaluator: root authored deterministic shared requirement tests; not independent or blind
scope: controller behavior with in-memory API; no DOM, rendering, keyboard or real network verification
limitations: One generated sample per arm; model revision and seed not exposed.
Shared filesystem is not an enforced holdout.
I14 checks unknown-outcome safety only; it does not prove recovery affordance or liveness.
API exactly-once behavior is a simulation contract, not a production guarantee.
